# raff_k8s_cluster (Data Source)

Reads an existing Kubernetes cluster by its short cluster ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Short cluster ID.

### Read-Only

- `api_endpoint` (String)
- `ha_enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `k8s_version` (String)
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive)
- `name` (String)
- `ready` (Boolean)
- `status` (String)
- `worker_count` (Number)
